sentences.en: Good morning.
sentences.zh: 早上好。

sentences.en: My name's Erica Matthews, and I'm the owner of Matthews Island Holidays, a company set up by my parents.
sentences.zh: 我叫埃丽卡·马修斯，是马修斯岛假日公司的老板，这家公司由我的父母创办。

sentences.en: Thank you for coming to this presentation, in which hope to interest you in what we have to offer.
sentences.zh: 感谢各位来参加本次介绍会，我希望借此引起大家对我们所提供服务的兴趣。

sentences.en: We're a small, family-run company, and we believe in the importance of the personal touch, so we don't aim to compete with other companies on the number of customers.
sentences.zh: 我们是一家小型家族经营企业，坚信个性化服务的重要性，因此我们的目标并非在客户数量上与其他公司竞争。

sentences.en: What we do is build on our many years' experience - more than almost any other rail holiday company - to ensure we provide perfect holidays in a small number of destinations, which we've got to know extremely well.
sentences.zh: 我们所做的，是依托多年积累的经验——这一经验几乎超过其他任何铁路假日公司——确保在少数几个我们极为熟悉的旅游目的地提供完美的假日体验。

sentences.en: I'll start with our six-day Isle of Man holiday.
sentences.zh: 我先从为期六天的马恩岛假日之旅开始介绍。

sentences.en: This is a fascinating island in the Irish Sea, with to Wales to the south, England to the east, Scotland to the north and Northern Ireland to the west.
sentences.zh: 这是一座位于爱尔兰海中引人入胜的岛屿，南面是威尔士，东面是英格兰，北面是苏格兰，西面是北爱尔兰。

sentences.en: Our holiday starts in Heysham, where your tour manager will meet you, then you'll travel by ferry to the Isle of Man.
sentences.zh: 我们的假日之旅从黑斯汉姆开始，您的导游将在那里迎接您，随后您将乘渡轮前往马恩岛。

sentences.en: Some people prefer to fly from Luton instead, and another popular option is to go by train to Liverpool and take a ferry from there.
sentences.zh: 有些人更愿意从卢顿乘飞机出发；另一种受欢迎的选择是乘火车前往利物浦，再从那里搭乘渡轮。

sentences.en: You have five nights in the hotel, and the price covers five breakfasts and dinners, and lunch on the three days when there are organised trips: day four is free, and most people have lunch in a café or restaurant in Douglas.
sentences.zh: 您将在酒店入住五晚，费用包含五顿早餐和五顿晚餐，以及三天有组织行程当天的午餐：第四天为自由活动日，大多数人会在道格拉斯的咖啡馆或餐厅用午餐。

sentences.en: The price of the holiday includes the ferry to the Isle of Man, all travel on the island, the hotel, and the meals I've mentioned.
sentences.zh: 该假日之旅的费用已涵盖前往马恩岛的渡轮、岛上全部交通、酒店住宿以及我刚才提到的餐食。

sentences.en: Incidentally, we try to make booking our holidays as simple and fair as possible, so unlike with many companies, the price is the same whether you book six months in advance or at the last minute, and there's no supplement for single rooms in hotels.
sentences.zh: 顺便提一下，我们力求使预订流程尽可能简单、公平。因此，与许多公司不同，无论您是提前六个月预订还是临行前最后一刻预订，价格均保持一致；酒店单人间亦不额外加收费用。

sentences.en: If you make a booking then need to change the start date, for example because of illness, you're welcome to change to an alternative date or a different tour, for a small administrative fee.
sentences.zh: 如果您已预订但需要更改出发日期（例如因生病），欢迎您以少量行政手续费为代价，改期至其他日期或更换为其他行程。

sentences.en: OK, so what does the holiday consist of?
sentences.zh: 好的，那么这次假日之旅具体包括哪些内容呢？

sentences.en: Well, on day one you'll arrive in time for a short introduction by your tour manager, followed by dinner in the hotel.
sentences.zh: 第一天，您将准时抵达，并由导游为您作简短介绍，随后在酒店享用晚餐。

sentences.en: The dining room looks out at the river, close to where it flows into the harbour, and there's usually plenty of activity going on.
sentences.zh: 餐厅面向河流，紧邻河流汇入港口之处，通常十分热闹。

sentences.en: On day two you'll take the coach to the small town of Peel, on the way calling in at the Tynwald Exhibition.
sentences.zh: 第二天，您将乘坐长途汽车前往小城皮尔，途中将在廷瓦尔德展览馆稍作停留。

sentences.en: The Isle of Man isn't part of the United Kingdom, and it has its own Audioscripts parliament, called Tynwald.
sentences.zh: 马恩岛不属于联合王国，拥有自己的议会，名为廷瓦尔德。

sentences.en: It's claimed that this is the is world's oldest parliament that's still functioning, and that it dates back to 979.
sentences.zh: 据称，这是世界上现存最古老的仍在运作的议会，其历史可追溯至公元979年。

sentences.en: However, the earliest surviving reference to it is from 1422, sO perhaps it isn't quite as old as it claims!
sentences.zh: 然而，目前保存下来的最早相关记载出自1422年，因此它或许并不像宣称的那样古老！

sentences.en: Day three we have a trip to the mountain Snaefell.
sentences.zh: 第三天，我们将前往斯奈菲尔山。

sentences.en: This begins with a leisurely ride along the promenade in Douglas in a horse-drawn tram.
sentences.zh: 旅程始于在道格拉斯海滨大道乘坐马拉电车悠闲观光。

sentences.en: Then you board an electric train which takes you to the fishing village of Laxey.
sentences.zh: 接着，您将登上一列电动火车，前往渔村拉克西。

sentences.en: From there it's an eight-kilometre ride in the Snaefell Mountain Railway to the top.
sentences.zh: 随后，您将乘坐斯奈菲尔山铁路列车行驶八公里，抵达山顶。

sentences.en: Lunch will be in the café, giving you spectacular views of the island.
sentences.zh: 午餐将在山顶咖啡馆享用，您可饱览全岛壮丽景色。

sentences.en: Day four is free for you to explore, using the pass which we'll give you.
sentences.zh: 第四天为自由活动日，您可凭我们提供的通票自由探索。

sentences.en: So you won't have to pay for travel on local transport, or for entrance to the island's heritage sites.
sentences.zh: 因此，您无需支付当地公共交通费用，也无需支付马恩岛各遗产景点的入场费。

sentences.en: Or you might just want to take it easy in Douglas and perhaps do a little light shopping.
sentences.zh: 或者，您也可以选择在道格拉斯轻松休憩，顺便进行一些轻松购物。

sentences.en: The last full day, day five, is for some people the highlight of the holiday, with a ride on the steam railway, from Douglas to Port Erin.
sentences.zh: 最后一天即第五天，对部分游客而言是整个假日之旅的亮点——乘坐蒸汽火车从道格拉斯前往波特艾琳。

sentences.en: After some time to explore, a coach will take you to the headland that overlooks the Calf of Man, a small island just off the coast.
sentences.zh: 游览一段时间后，长途汽车将带您前往俯瞰曼岛小犊岛的海岬，那是一个紧邻海岸的小岛。

sentences.en: From there you continue to Castletown, which used to be the capital of the Isle of Man, and its medieval castle.
sentences.zh: 接着，您将继续前往卡斯特敦——马恩岛昔日的首都及其中世纪城堡。

sentences.en: And on day six it's back to the ferry or the airport, if you flew to the island - and time to go home.
sentences.zh: 第六天，您将返回渡轮码头或机场（若您是乘飞机抵达马恩岛），踏上归途。

sentences.en: Now 'd like to tell you ...
sentences.zh: 接下来，我想向各位介绍……
